title: console-tooling-standup-2026-03-17
summary: Weekly engineering standup notes for Console & Tooling (UI, rollouts, analytics). Focus this week: rollout editor polish, rollout preview bug, analytics instrumentation for per-rollout metrics, and a small experimental Canary UI for dedicated customers.
notes:
Attendees: Sofia Martinez (owner), Benji Rao, Mei Wong, Carlos Diaz, Priya Nair, Ellen Brooks

Agenda:
- Quick sync on in-progress items (UI, rollouts, analytics)
- Blockers & escalations
- Demos / screenshots for PMs
- Action items & owners

Updates:
1) UI / Rollout Editor (Sofia + Benji)
- What: Shipping the third iteration of the rollout editor UI (multi-variant support, conditional routing).
- Progress: Feature branch merged into staging; smoke tests passing. Frontend changes include new variant table, inline validation for traffic weights, and improved error states.
- Blocker: Preview panel intermittently fails to render when a rollout references a model variant that was recently deprecated. Root cause: backend returns 204 for missing variant and UI code treats 204 as success with empty payload.
- Next steps: Benji to add explicit 404 handling and a retry path; implement a user-facing warning when variant is deprecated. Ticket: JIRA-RINF-4321.

2) Rollout Service / Backend (Mei + Carlos)
- What: API changes to support canary traffic split and deterministic rollout IDs.
- Progress: Endpoint stable in staging. Added schema validation for rollout config.
- Blocker: High flakiness in rollout preview endpoint under concurrency (seen in internal load tests). Likely related to cache invalidation race when multiple edits happen quickly.
- Next steps: Carlos to add a short write-lock around config update and add metrics to trace cache invalidation events. Mei to run targeted load tests. Ticket: JIRA-RINF-4387.

3) Analytics / Instrumentation (Priya + Ellen)
- What: Per-rollout metrics (latency p50/p95, token cost, error-rate) and dashboard templates in Redwood Console.
- Progress: Backend emits rollout_id tag on traces and metrics; initial Grafana dashboards created.
- Blocker: Some legacy routes do not propagate rollout_id; a handful of SDK integrations strip custom headers. This causes gaps in metrics for older customer integrations.
- Next steps: Priya to coordinate with SDK owners to add a fallback header, Ellen to add a data-completeness alert to detect missing rollout_id percentages.

4) Canary UI for Dedicated Customers (Sofia)
- What: Lightweight UI in Console to enable dedicated customers to preview rollout behavior in a sandboxed environment.
- Progress: Prototype screenshots shared with PMs; backend sandboxing support under review.
- Decision needed: PMs to confirm whether sandbox should allow replay of live traffic or only synthetic traffic. Action: PM sync scheduled 2026-03-18.

Blockers / Risks:
- Rollout preview flakiness (high priority) — could block ship of rollout editor GA.
- Missing rollout_id propagation — analytics gaps could lead to missed regressions.
- Timebox: Team decided not to delay GA for full SDK rollout; we will ship with a known fallback and a ticket to remediate SDK integrations within two sprints.

Demos / Screenshots:
- Benji will post final staging screenshots in the #console-rollouts channel by EOD 2026-03-17.

Action Items (owners + due dates):
- Benji: Fix 204 vs 404 handling in preview UI + add warning for deprecated variants (JIRA-RINF-4321) — due 2026-03-19.
- Carlos: Add short write-lock on config update and instrument cache-invalidation metrics (JIRA-RINF-4387) — due 2026-03-20.
- Mei: Run targeted concurrency load tests for rollout preview and report findings — due 2026-03-19.
- Priya: Coordinate SDK owners about rollout_id header fallback; draft rollout plan — due 2026-03-24.
- Ellen: Create data-completeness alert and dashboard panel for missing rollout_id — due 2026-03-22.
- Sofia: Prepare canary UI decision doc and sync with PMs — due 2026-03-18.

Decisions Made:
- Ship rollout editor GA with fallback behavior for missing rollout_id (temporary) and track SDK remediation in a separate epic.
- Canary UI will be initially limited to synthetic traffic until PMs decide on live traffic replay.

Follow-ups / Notes:
- Link to design doc: https://confluence.redwood.internal/display/CON/Console+Rollouts+Design
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/987 (Benji)
- Load-test logs: internal artifact linked in Slack thread (see linked_artifacts).

Misc / Notes to self:
- Remember to include QA in release checklist for rollout preview edge cases.
- Schedule a cross-team sync with SDK owners next week (suggested: 2026-03-23).

Next standup: 2026-03-24 10:00 PT
